user_goal.text: Carry out every task in the user's Camping Trip Planning Todoist project and mark them all complete.

benchmark_success.rationale: Frozen TestTracker success is the conjunction of every registered test.

checked_by.text: The official evaluate function applies TestTracker to the retained answer and start/end model state; success requires all 24 registered tests to pass.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained TestTracker evaluation result with pass and failure lists
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the result report success with all 24 registered requirements passing and no registered failures?

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.

additional_conditions.text: Require the retained active supervisor task record to have status "success", confirming that task completion was committed.
additional_conditions.rationale: The official instruction asks for the tasks to be done, but the evaluator assigns this predicate only to an unregistered dynamic attribute, so native TestTracker success does not require it.
